title: Receipts/ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssemblyTests.cs: requirement test fails on base (4/4), passes on head (4/4); refutes 1 lens claim(s): requirement-tests-1

refutes.claim: The reporter names three unguarded `DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]` sites: base lines 735, 1009 and 1101. The diff guards only the two diagnostic sites (now 985 and 1077). The site around base line 735 in `GetObjectInfo` is left unchanged. If that path indexes `DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]` outside a `reportDiagnostic?.Invoke(...)` argument, it still throws `IndexOutOfRangeException` in both generator and analyzer mode. The new `ReportIfLocatedInCompilation` wrapper only filters diagnostics after they are created, so it cannot prevent an indexing crash there. The generator also had CS8785 in the bug report. Since the generator has no analyzer sink, its `?.Invoke` arguments are never evaluated, so the generator crash must come from an eagerly evaluated path. The 1077 site is one such path; the 735 site may be another.
